root_cause.trajectory_summary: The agent inspected the repository (Turn 1) and read the input script (Turn 2). It analyzed the script structure with a Python scan to confirm section formatting and that each section contains either a single speaker line or a set of numbered choices, finding no mixed or nonconforming lines (Turn 3). It attempted to locate an [End] section and references, made a grep syntax error (Turn 4), then corrected it and confirmed that “-> End” is referenced while “[End]” is not defined (Turn 5). It computed reachability and target completeness, confirming all nodes are reachable from Start and that End is the only missing target (Turn 6). The agent then implemented /app/solution.py with parse_script, graph validation, and DOT export (Turn 7), executed it to generate /app/dialogue.json and /app/dialogue.dot (Turns 9–12), and verified basic output statistics (205 nodes, 321 edges) and that an implicit End node exists.

what_worked.item: Turn 3: Correctly validated script conformity; tool result shows “mixed [] count 0” and “nonconforming lines 0”, supporting the chosen parsing assumptions.
Turn 6: Correctly checked graph constraints up front; tool result shows “unreachable count 0” and “missing section for targets ['End']”, matching the task’s exception allowance for an implicit End.
Turn 7: Implemented parse_script plus validation and DOT export; solution.py includes node/edge construction with required fields and a reachability check in _validate_graph.
Turns 9–12: Successfully generated required artifacts; python run exited 0 (Turn 9) and /app contains dialogue.json and dialogue.dot (Turn 12).
Turn 10: Verified output shape and key node properties; observation shows first node has speaker/text/type and End node exists: “end node {'id': 'End', ...}”.

issue.evidence: The command “grep -n '-> End' /app/script.txt | head” failed with “grep: invalid option -- '>'”.
issue.cause: Shell/grep parsing error: the pattern beginning with “->” was interpreted as options because “--” was not used before the pattern.

issue.evidence: The agent attempted to run two separate commands in one tool call; tool returned “Cannot execute multiple commands at once.”
issue.cause: Misunderstanding of the terminal tool constraint; multiple commands must be run separately (or properly chained within a single command per tool rules).

root_cause.outcome_assessment: The required parser function was implemented and executed to produce /app/dialogue.json and /app/dialogue.dot, with validated reachability and an implicit End node added as evidenced by the successful run (Turn 9), file existence (Turn 12), and JSON inspection (Turn 10).
